description: Central source identifier table keyed by the site country code. Display names, slugs, regions, and navigation categories remain in src/countries.js.

sourceIds.unNationalAccounts: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
sourceIds.unsdArea: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

unWpp.description: Use the site country code unless sourceIds.unWpp overrides it.

unMigrantStock.description: UN DESA International Migrant Stock uses M49 location codes; sourceIds.unMigrantStock is required for matched countries.

worldBankWdi.description: World Bank WDI update scripts try sourceIds.worldBankWdi, then the site country code, then the display name.

worldBankAgeComposition.description: World Bank age-composition script uses sourceIds.worldBankAgeComposition.

unctadServicesTrade.description: UNCTAD services trade script uses sourceIds.unctadServicesTrade.

unComtradeReporter.description: UN Comtrade reporter IDs use sourceIds.unComtradeReporter.

unComtradeIsoFallback.description: UN Comtrade ISO fallback IDs use sourceIds.unComtradeIsoFallback.

worldMapTopojson.description: The world map first uses sourceIds.worldMapTopojson, then falls back to normalized names.

oecdRevenue.description: OECD revenue composition script uses sourceIds.oecdRevenue.

unNationalAccounts.description: UN National Accounts scripts use sourceIds.unNationalAccounts.

undpHdi.description: UNDP HDI uses the site country code unless sourceIds.undpHdi overrides it.
